en.headline: Hotstone Yoga shuts all studios after sudden notice
en.dek: The hot-stone yoga chain told customers it would stop classes after Wednesday's hours, citing business circumstances, as members said packages were still being sold days earlier.
body: Hotstone Yoga, a hot-stone yoga chain that has operated in Hong Kong for more than a decade, closed all of its studios after a notice issued on Wednesday, the company and local reports said.

A notice sent through the firm's lawyers, and reported by the South China Morning Post and HK01, said the company had decided after careful consideration to cease operations because of business conditions and other circumstances. It said classes, packages and other services would stop once Wednesday's opening hours ended, and invited people with claims to submit documents. Headline Daily reported that September wages and class fees for affected staff were to be paid by 5 October, and that written claims were asked for by the same date.

HK01 reported the chain had described itself as the city's first hot-stone yoga studio, with more than 100 instructors and as many as seven branches at its peak, offering yoga, dance and fitness classes. Its website and Instagram account were later taken down, the outlet said.

Customers told reporters they had not been warned. Some said staff were still selling packages in the days, and in some cases hours, before the shutdown. HK01 said a members' group had grown to nearly 500 people, and that some had reported the case to police and the Consumer Council. The company has not publicly detailed how prepaid packages will be refunded.

zh.headline: Hotstone Yoga全線結業 學員稱結業前仍售套票
zh.dek: 岩盤瑜伽連鎖店周三發出通告，指因業務情況於當日營業時間後停止課程；有學員稱數日前仍被推銷續會。
body: 經營逾十年、主打岩盤瑜伽的Hotstone Yoga，周三發出通告後全線停止營業。
《南華早報》及香港01報道，公司經律師發出的通告稱，因業務經營及其他實際情況，經審慎考慮後決定結業，周三營業時間結束後不再提供課程、套票或其他服務，並請持有申索的人士提交文件。《頭條日報》報道，受影響員工的九月工資及堂費將於10月5日或之前發放，書面索償亦須於同日前提交。
香港01報道，該店曾自稱全港首創岩盤瑜伽，高峰期有七間分店、逾百名導師，課程包括瑜伽、跳舞及健身。報道指其網站及Instagram其後已刪除。
有顧客向傳媒表示事前未獲通知，部分人稱結業前數日甚至數小時仍被推銷套票。香港01稱苦主群組已近500人，有人已報警及向消委會投訴。公司暫未公開說明預繳套票如何退款。
